The retained molecular PC-SAFT declarations reproduce the selected dew-curve
readings. Bubble-curve temperatures remain outside the source-reading bounds.
The tighter solve and bounded inverse/association checks do not explain that
disagreement. Its cause remains undetermined. These are numerical-verification
comparisons with the paper's predictions; agreement with measurements is a
separate physical comparison. This attempt does not establish physical validation
of an MDEA application model or complete the reactive part of the paper.

```{python}
import csv, gzip, json
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root = Path.cwd()
source = root / 'inputs/source'
run = json.loads(gzip.decompress((root / 'results/native-results.json.gz').read_bytes()))
diag = json.loads((root / 'results/diagnosis.json').read_text())
with (root / 'results/comparisons.csv').open() as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
with (source / 'mdea-cases.csv').open() as f:
    cases = list(csv.DictReader(f))
cal = json.loads((source / 'figure-calibration.json').read_text())
def table(headers, data):
    display(Markdown('| '+' | '.join(headers)+' |\n| '+' | '.join(['---']*len(headers))+' |\n'+'\n'.join('| '+' | '.join(map(str,r))+' |' for r in data)))
model = [r for r in rows if r['prediction'] and r['series'] != 'measured']
measured = [r for r in rows if r['prediction'] and r['series'] == 'measured']
points = run['points']
```

The source is Nasrifar and Tafazzol (2010), DOI
[10.1021/ie901181n](https://doi.org/10.1021/ie901181n), Tables 1–3 and Figures
6–7 and 15–17. The adopted packet declares neutral molecules, MDEA 3B, water
2B, sigma-cubed association, the Wolbach–Sandler combining rule and the
published binary interactions. It includes no polar or electrolyte terms.
The packet is materialized byte-for-byte; its [provenance](inputs/parameters/provenance.json)
binds the file hash and complete-packet fingerprint. Molar masses have
independent repository/formula provenance. No parameters were fitted here.

## Original cases

```{python}
case_rows = []
for case in cases:
    selected = [r for r in model if r['panel'] == case['figure']]
    description = f"dew {sum(r['outcome']=='reproduced' for r in selected if r['series']=='dew')}/{sum(r['series']=='dew' for r in selected)}; bubble {sum(r['outcome']=='reproduced' for r in selected if r['series']=='bubble')}/{sum(r['series']=='bubble' for r in selected)} within rectangles; bubble cause undetermined" if selected else ('scoring withheld: printed axis conflicts with caption; no guessed inputs' if case['figure']=='7' else 'unavailable: Engine #776')
    case_rows.append([case['figure'], case['system'], description])
table(['Figure','System','Outcome'], case_rows)
```

## Neutral comparisons

Horizontal coordinates are liquid MDEA mole fractions for bubbles and vapor
MDEA mole fractions for dews. Source model readings are points with fixed
source-reading rectangles. Native values are independent evaluations at those
coordinates and both horizontal bounds; they are not an interpolated curve.
The lower branch disagrees despite small defining-equation residuals. Upper
branch agreement alone cannot verify the entire binary model.

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,4),layout='constrained')
for ax,panel in zip(axes,['6a','6b','6c']):
    for series,color in [('dew','#0072B2'),('bubble','#D55E00')]:
        data = [r for r in model if r['panel']==panel and r['series']==series]
        x,y = [float(r['source_x']) for r in data],[float(r['source_y']) for r in data]
        ax.errorbar(x,y,xerr=[float(r['x_half_width']) for r in data],yerr=[float(r['y_half_width']) for r in data],fmt='o',color=color,label=f'paper {series}')
        ax.plot(x,[float(r['prediction']) for r in data],'x',color=color,label=f'Engine {series}')
    ax.set(title=f"Figure {panel}: {float(data[0]['pressure_Pa'])/1000:g} kPa",xlabel='MDEA mole fraction',ylabel='Temperature / K')
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.show()
table(['Figure','Branch','Targets within bounds','Center difference range / K'],[[p,s,f"{sum(r['outcome']=='reproduced' for r in model if r['panel']==p and r['series']==s)}/{sum(r['panel']==p and r['series']==s for r in model)}",f"{min(float(r['delta']) for r in model if r['panel']==p and r['series']==s):.3f} to {max(float(r['delta']) for r in model if r['panel']==p and r['series']==s):.3f}"] for p in ['6a','6b','6c'] for s in ['dew','bubble']])
table(['Figure','Measured-marker outcome','Center difference range / K'],[[p,', '.join(sorted({r['outcome'] for r in measured if r['panel']==p})),f"{min(float(r['delta']) for r in measured if r['panel']==p):.3f} to {max(float(r['delta']) for r in measured if r['panel']==p):.3f}"] for p in ['6a','6b','6c']])
```

Figure 6c model values use the paper's printed pressure. Its measured markers
have a separate primary-source pressure; those differences are descriptive,
with scoring withheld until condition ownership is resolved. Figure 7 retains
the printed MDEA mole-fraction axis and methane-solubility caption as conflicting
source information. No methane coordinate was substituted. The missing primary
Voutsas and Jou tables are identified in the [source notes](inputs/source/README.md).

## Numerical verification and reading limits

```{python}
refinements = []
for point in points:
    if point['requested_tolerance'] == 1e-11:
        original = next(p for p in points if p['row_id']==point['row_id'] and p['offset']==0 and p['requested_tolerance']==1e-10)
        target = next(r for r in rows if r['row_id']==point['row_id'])
        refinements.append([point['row_id'],abs(point['temperature_K']-original['temperature_K']),float(target['y_half_width'])*0.01])
table(['Quantity','Retained value'],[['Native evaluations',len(points)],['Maximum scaled residual',max(p['convergence']['residual'] for p in points)],['Requested residual tolerance',points[0]['requested_tolerance']],['Temperature range / K',f"{min(p['temperature_K'] for p in points):.6f} to {max(p['temperature_K'] for p in points):.6f}"],['Run wall time / s',run['wall_seconds']],['Pixel half-width per coordinate',cal['coordinate_half_width_px']],['Figure targets',len([r for r in rows if r['panel'] in cal['panels']])],['Unavailable measured table rows',sum(r['y_scale']=='linear Pa' for r in rows)]])
table(['Refinement point','Temperature change / K','Limit: 1% reading half-width / K'],refinements)
table(['Bounded diagnostic','Temperature / K','Pressure / Pa','Maximum scaled residual'],[[r['name'],r['temperature_K'],r['pressure_Pa'],max(map(abs,r['residuals']))] for r in diag['records']])
```

All native results retain phase amounts, mole fractions, densities, packing
fractions, equation residuals, stopping evidence, inner association/density
residual maxima and execution identity. Full traces remain in the archived
build directory. The refinement change is below the fixed share of reading
resolution. The inverse bubble-pressure solve and the equivalent MDEA A/B-site
multiplicity swap retain the same equilibrium point. Thus neither requested
row tolerance nor the equivalent site orientation explains the discrepancy;
no Engine defect has been established. No parameter change or tolerance
relaxation is adopted. Declared phases and local closure do not establish global
phase stability. The high-temperature dew states extrapolate the Table 3
MDEA–water interaction fit interval; per-row notes retain that limitation.

## Reactive source targets and limits

Figure 15's isolated species curves are retained in log10 mole-fraction
coordinates, solely as source model targets. Overlapping bicarbonate and
protonated-MDEA curves do not identify separate fractions or their sum.
Figure 16 and Figure 17 model curves are **not digitized: ambiguous ownership**.
Kamps Tables 2–3 and Rho Tables 1 and 3 supply the measured total/partial-pressure
rows. Their original conditions and decimal precision remain in the source
CSVs. Every target remains in [comparisons.csv](results/comparisons.csv) with
an unavailable cause. Rho's measured composition and the Figure 17b model
composition remain distinct; no rescaling is performed.

The pressure criterion is half the last printed digit, with Kamps' printed
`10p/MPa` and Rho's kPa units mapped once into Pa. It is agreement to print,
not experimental uncertainty. The separate reported experimental uncertainties
and input rounding are described in the source notes; they cannot supply a
row pressure band when transducer identity or complete uncertainty is missing.

[Engine #776](https://github.com/tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT/issues/776) owns ideal
mole-fraction reaction equilibrium and the native effective-water conversion.
The falsifier is the source R1 water/hydroxide/hydronium ideal equilibrium,
with positive normalized fractions, charge closure, conserved water-equivalent
amount and logarithmic mass-action closure at the prescribed residual tolerance.
The delivered numerical verification of that independent ideal calculation
is recorded below. Subsequent molecular VLE already exists; the unperformed
paper comparisons remain unavailable. The required
conversion retains free molecular acid gas and MDEA and replaces water with
true water plus the named ionic amounts. No Python chemistry is used here.

Separately, the paper prints hydronium stoichiometry but omits hydronium from
its Eq. (12) water balance: the R1 reaction vector has a nonzero contraction
with that printed water functional. This source inconsistency is not an Engine
conservation defect. Neither a proton substitution nor a corrected balance is
claimed as the authors' calculation. Pure-MDEA controls and aggregate fit errors
remain outside this original-case reproduction.

### Engine ideal mole-fraction numerical verification

The delivered Engine checks now provide cold single-liquid speciation with
ideal mole-fraction activities and native effective-water amounts. The
following tables read [retained native values](results/ideal-mole-fraction.json.gz)
from the refreshed `ideal-mole-fraction` check in PR #785; they do not run the
model. The refreshed values are identical to the original delivered values.
The native record retains all comparison operands, source-law values, species
amounts and fractions, rows, endpoint rank, conditioning and consumed work.
The equations and source locators are owned by
[ideal mole-fraction reaction equilibrium](../../../engine/docs/equations.md#ideal_mole_fraction_reaction)
and [effective-water amounts](../../../engine/docs/equations.md#effective_water_amounts).
Nasrifar Table 1 supplies the reaction constants; the first left-block rows
of Kamps Tables 2 and 3 supply the two acid-gas feed declarations. These are
Engine reference checks, separate from the unavailable paper comparisons above.

```{python}
ideal = json.loads(gzip.decompress((root / 'results/ideal-mole-fraction.json.gz').read_bytes()))
checks = ideal['comparisons']
by_name = {r['comparison_id']: r for r in checks}
def deviation(name):
    r = by_name[name]
    return abs(r['model'] - r['reference'])
def largest(names):
    return max(deviation(name) for name in names)
r1 = by_name['R1-log-mass-action']['inputs']
acid = {gas: by_name[f'{gas}-R1']['inputs'] for gas in ['CO2', 'H2S']}
table(['Case', 'Temperature / K', 'Pressure / Pa', 'Initial amounts / mol', 'Reactions'], [
    ['R1', r1['T_K'], r1['P_Pa'], f"water: {r1['N_mol']}", 'R1'],
    *[[gas, data['T_K'], data['P_Pa'], ', '.join(f'{s}: {n:.12g}' for s, n in zip(data['species'], data['feed_mol']) if n),
       'R1/R2/R3/R6' if gas == 'CO2' else 'R1/R4/R5/R6'] for gas, data in acid.items()]
])
table(['R1 species', 'Mole fraction'], zip(r1['species'], r1['x']))
table(['R1 verification quantity', 'Absolute error', 'Limit', 'Unit'], [
    [name, deviation(name), by_name[name]['atol'], by_name[name]['unit']]
    for name in ['R1-log-mass-action', 'R1-water', 'R1-log-ion-1', 'R1-log-ion-2',
                 'R1-W', 'R1-normalization', 'R1-charge', 'R1-effective-water', 'log-reference-scale']
])
```

R1 agrees with the analytical water-autoprotolysis fractions, including the
trace-ion logarithms. The acid-gas cases use one kilogram of initial water;
the retained mol amounts use the source-backed water molar mass declared in
the native check. All reaction laws are evaluated within their printed fit
intervals. The returned fractions and conserved inventories verify the
declared ideal chemistry. They do not quantify the physical error of unit
ionic activity coefficients.

```{python}
table(['Case', 'Species', 'Amount / mol', 'Mole fraction'], [
    [gas, species, n, x] for gas, data in acid.items()
    for species, n, x in zip(data['species'], data['n_mol'], data['x'])
])
table(['Case', 'Maximum log mass-action error', 'Maximum inventory/charge error / mol',
       'Normalization error', 'Endpoint rank', 'Condition estimate'], [
    [gas, largest(f'{gas}-{r}' for r in (['R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R6'] if gas == 'CO2' else ['R1', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6'])),
     largest(f'{gas}-{r}' for r in ['W', 'M', 'gas', 'charge']), deviation(f'{gas}-normalization'),
     f"{data['rank']}/{len(data['species'])}", data['condition']]
    for gas, data in acid.items()
])
table(['Comparison', 'Absolute error limit', 'Unit'], [[name, by_name[f'CO2-{name}']['atol'], by_name[f'CO2-{name}']['unit']] for name in ['R1', 'W', 'normalization']])
table(['Case', 'Effective water / mol', 'Free MDEA / mol', 'Free acid gas / mol', 'Speciated total / mol'], [
    [gas, data['effective_water_mol'], by_name[f'{gas}-free-MDEA']['model'],
     by_name[f'{gas}-free-gas']['model'], by_name[f'{gas}-converted-total']['reference']]
    for gas, data in acid.items()
])
table(['Conversion invariant', 'CO2 absolute error / mol', 'H2S absolute error / mol', 'Limit / mol'], [
    [name, deviation(f'CO2-{name}'), deviation(f'H2S-{name}'), by_name[f'CO2-{name}']['atol']]
    for name in ['converted-total', 'free-MDEA', 'free-gas', 'effective-water', 'effective-inventory', 'changed-total']
])
```

The conversion preserves each free molecular amount and the **speciated mole
total**. It does not generally preserve the initial feed mole total: the CO2
reaction subset changes that total. Effective water includes every declared
ion; it is distinct from the conserved water-equivalent inventory. The
molecular representation cannot replace the true-species inventory record.

```{python}
derivative = by_name['Jacobian-analytical']['inputs']
table(['Derivative condition', 'Retained value'], [
    ['Log-amount coordinates', derivative['y']], ['Direction', derivative['direction']],
    ['Selected material row', derivative['B_row']], ['Row multipliers', derivative['weights']],
    ['Analytical Hessian action', derivative['hstar']]
])
table(['Exact derivative comparison', 'Maximum scaled error', 'Limit'], [
    [name, deviation(name), by_name[name]['atol']]
    for name in ['Jacobian-analytical', 'Hessian-action-analytical']
])
jacobian_steps = [r for r in checks if r['comparison_id'] == 'Jacobian-centered']
hessian_steps = [r for r in checks if r['comparison_id'] == 'Hessian-action-centered']
table(['Centered step', 'Jacobian difference/analytical error', 'Jacobian native/difference error',
       'Hessian-action difference/analytical error', 'Hessian-action native/difference error'], [
    [j['inputs']['step'], j['inputs']['E_J_fd'], abs(j['model']-j['reference']),
     h['inputs']['E_H_fd'], abs(h['model']-h['reference'])]
    for j, h in zip(jacobian_steps, hessian_steps)
])
pressure = by_name['pressure-n-0']['inputs']
table(['Pressure invariant', 'Retained value'], [
    ['Compared pressures / Pa', [pressure['P_Pa'], pressure['other_P_Pa']]],
    ['Maximum species-amount difference / mol', largest(f'pressure-n-{i}' for i in range(len(pressure['species'])))],
    ['Maximum species-fraction difference', largest(f'pressure-x-{i}' for i in range(len(pressure['species'])))],
    ['Maximum fraction of declared comparison limit', max(deviation(r['comparison_id'])/r['atol'] for r in checks if r['comparison_id'].startswith('pressure-'))]
])
```

The positive derivative point need not be an equilibrium solution. Its nonzero
reaction and material multipliers expose both composition-normalization and
exponential-inventory curvature. Centered differences are verification only;
they never enter a solve. The errors decrease over the retained steps, and the
finest-step comparisons meet their native Jacobian and Hessian-action limits.
The reduction now rejects nonfinite operands or differences. Tables are used
for these few scalar reference checks and selected steps; no continuous
physical curve is inferred. Pressure is absent from the ideal chemistry rows,
so equality between the declared pressures verifies an invariant rather than
a pressure prediction.

Ideal warm starts remain refused before compilation or reaction-law work;
there is no implicit cold retry. These results are **numerical verification
only**. They provide no physical validation of ideal ionic activities, no
Figure 15 reproduction, no agreement with the paper's printed water balance
and no prediction of the measured pressures. Hot-condition extrapolation is
deferred. Source-coefficient uncertainty, ideal-activity model error and global
solution uniqueness are not established by these residuals. All unperformed
#734 paper comparisons remain unavailable. Independent review of this
correction and notebook remains with the lead; no investigator promotion or
